reason: I already drive to Tawfeer once a week and fill the boot, so I'm not paying someone to shop for me. I like choosing my own tomatoes and checking prices on the shelf myself.
objection: I can't see what I'd be getting that I don't already get by going myself. I'd be trusting a stranger to pick my produce and I only see the receipt afterwards.
would_change_my_mind: Proof, on my own list over a few weeks, that the total comes out clearly cheaper than my weekly shop even after the fee, with a way to send back anything that is bad.
